question: What is the meaning of building information modeling (bim) details in relation to product information, component information, design specifications?
data_group: product information, component information, design specifications
description: Building Information Modeling (BIM) details in relation to product information involve the creation and management of information for a built asset, encompassing product details such as component information and design specifications. BIM serves as a central tool in facilitating the exchange of building information, ensuring seamless transfer of data from the initial design stages to the final product handover and throughout its operation. The use of BIM tools and methods helps consolidate, integrate, and validate various BIM models, which may include detailed product information, component specifications, and design details.
